examples.label: Day, week or month picker
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-floating-indicator" site="Global" id="range-picker" active="week" label="Range"><:target value="day">Day</:target><:target value="week">Week</:target><:target value="month">Month</:target></.component>

examples.label: Two-way toggle
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-headless-floating-indicator" site="Global" id="theme-picker" active="light" label="Theme"><:target value="light">Light</:target><:target value="dark">Dark</:target></.component>
